# codebase-ema

The canonical EMA daemon snapshot. Contains the live `control_plane/`
(event_log, store, replay, execution_supervisor, incidents/*, proposal_events),
`babysitter/`, `sessions/`, and `surfaces/hermes_client.ex` — i.e. the
EMA-truth / Hermes-execution split is already real in code, not just doctrine.
Holds ClaudeForge under `code/ema/claudeforge/` and the working
`hermes-provider.ts` seam.

## Why this matters

The canonical core. Holds **working code** for the EMA-truth / Hermes-execution split: `control_plane/` (event_log, store, replay, execution_supervisor, incidents/*, proposal_events, persistence, schema, supervisor), `babysitter/`, `sessions/`, and `surfaces/hermes_client.ex`. Also contains a sanitized snapshot of ClaudeForge (`code/ema/claudeforge/`) with a working `hermes-provider.ts` seam.

## What lives here

- `code/ema/daemon/lib/ema/control_plane/` — authority
- `code/ema/daemon/lib/ema/babysitter/` — OpenClaw doctrine, crystallized
- `code/ema/daemon/lib/ema/sessions/` — session identity
- `code/ema/daemon/lib/ema/surfaces/hermes_client.ex` — surface↔Hermes seam
- `code/ema/daemon/lib/ema/second_brain/indexer.ex` — memory index
- `code/ema/docs/AGENT-CONTRACT.md` — capability locality
- `code/ema/docs/HERMES-EMA-AI-ENGINE-INTERFACE-PLAN.md`
- `code/ema/docs/HERMES_HARNESS_DRIVER_REGISTRY.md`
- `code/ema/workspace/shared/exports/HERMES_EMA_LINEAGE_META_HARNESS_AUDIT_2026-04-22.md`
- `code/ema/claudeforge/packages/server/src/providers/hermes-provider.ts`

## How to load it efficiently

Don't check out the whole branch. Pull only the artifact you need:
```bash
git show origin/codebase-ema:code/ema/docs/AGENT-CONTRACT.md
git show origin/codebase-ema:code/ema/docs/HERMES_HARNESS_DRIVER_REGISTRY.md
```
